checks.evidence: AvailabilityPointer.tsx:9 now text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300. blue-700 (#1d4ed8) on slate-50 is 6.41:1; blue-300 (#93c5fd) on slate-800/50 over the dark card (#1d2a39) is 8.09:1 (8.07:1 on the card alone). Both above 4.5:1; underline kept.

AvailabilityContent.tsx handleReload now calls setFocusTarget(WEEKLY_HOURS_TITLE_ID) after adopt and clearing the error, and it does so whether or not result.data exists, so the unmounted banner never leaves focus on body. The heading has tabIndex=-1 (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:101 focusableTitle). AvailabilityContent.actions.test.tsx CONFLICT test asserts document.activeElement is the level-2 'Weekly hours' heading.

AppointmentDetail.tsx: <dialog aria-labelledby={DIALOG_TITLE_ID}> and all five h3 titles (complete, cancel, reschedule, addAttendee, linkCase) carry that id; they render under mutually exclusive activeDialog conditions, so the id is unique in the DOM. AppointmentDetail.test.tsx asserts getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Reschedule Appointment' }).

confirmReset catch sets serverError and focusOnResetCloseRef = SERVER_ERROR_ID; the banner has id={SERVER_ERROR_ID} and tabIndex=-1 (AvailabilityBanners.tsx:8,88-90). ConfirmationDialog still closes after onConfirm resolves (confirmation-dialog.tsx:79-81), and onCloseAutoFocus preventDefaults and focuses the banner, which is already committed at that point. The ref is consumed on every close (set to null before use), so a later Cancel is not hijacked. Test asserts focus is on the role=alert. Success path still focuses the Weekly hours title via the same ref.

AppointmentDetail.tsx: Escape listener is its own effect with early return when !activeDialog || isActionLoading and deps [activeDialog, isActionLoading], removed on cleanup. The actionError-clearing effect is keyed on [activeDialog] only, so a failed action (isActionLoading flip) does not clear the error. Re-enables once the action settles on failure. Test 'ignores Escape while the dialog action is running' covers it. Residual: no event.defaultPrevented check for an inner popover (optional).
